payload.summary: Draft PR #363 is open for openspec/harden-review-consensus-and-recovery. The pushed implementation head is 4f64bb1c; all nine round-4 source blockers were remediated, but the operator-approved round-5 retry still produced external quorum 0/4, so autopilot remains in ESCALATE without a review waiver. The Aug 8 PR run had three failing jobs: eight legacy dispatcher-migration tests omit newly required terminal attempt-chain evidence, context drift reports a stale decision timeline plus unverifiable architecture provenance, and strict OpenSpec validation marked this change invalid. The OpenSpec failure is not reproducible with CLI 1.7.0 on a clean archive (67/67 pass), so it must be rechecked on the next CI run. The managed worktree has been restored and pinned for continuation.
completed_work: Rebased the feature onto origin/main, remediated all nine round-4 source-audited blockers, and pushed the implementation and review evidence through commit 4f64bb1c.

Ran the explicitly approved external implementation-review retry without waiving quorum; four logical reviewer slots produced eleven bounded attempts and no schema-valid terminal result, leaving quorum at 0/4.

Created draft PR #363 (https://github.com/jankneumann/agentic-coding-tools/pull/363); GitHub reports the head as mergeable but the PR as BLOCKED because it is draft and required gates have not passed.
Inspected CI run 31259496482 at implementation head 4f64bb1c: thirteen jobs passed and test-infra-skills, validate-specs, and context-drift-gate failed.
Localized test-infra-skills to eight failures in tests/parallel-infrastructure/test_review_dispatcher_migration.py, all raising ValueError: review manifests require terminal attempt-chain evidence.

Localized context-drift-gate to blocking decisions.timeline drift for docs/decisions/agent-archetypes.md and docs/decisions/skill-workflow.md plus an architecture producer failure that reported drift without naming an artifact.

Re-ran openspec validate --strict --all with OpenSpec 1.7.0 both in the managed worktree and from a clean git archive; both passed 67/67, so the Aug 8 validate-specs failure is currently non-reproducible and likely tool-version-sensitive.
Recreated and pinned the managed worktree at .git-worktrees/harden-review-consensus-and-recovery so a clean-context continuation has a stable checkout.
in_progress: Autopilot remains in ESCALATE at implementation-review iteration 5/5 because no external reviewer produced quorum-eligible output; implementation and validation review gates remain enabled.
Draft PR #363 requires a new CI run after this handoff commit and remediation of any reproducible failures before it can be marked ready.

The restored worktree contains generated untracked openspec/schemas/review-attempt.schema.json; it is intentionally excluded from this handoff commit and must not be deleted or staged without first determining its ownership and generation path.

decisions.title: Keep PR #363 in draft and preserve review gates
decisions.rationale: The operator approved creating the PR but did not waive implementation-review quorum or validation review. Draft status accurately exposes CI while preventing the branch from being presented as merge-ready.

decisions.title: Do not repeat the exhausted external reviewer chain unchanged
decisions.rationale: The authorized retry produced zero eligible results after bounded schema-invalid, fallback, replacement, and timeout attempts. Another cycle is useful only after reviewer output reliability or routing changes and requires new operator authorization.

decisions.title: Treat Aug 8 CI as a diagnostic baseline, not current proof
decisions.rationale: The CI run tested 4f64bb1c with floating tool dependencies. OpenSpec 1.7.0 now validates the same committed tree strictly, and pushing this handoff creates a new head and check suite that must be evaluated independently.

next_steps: Resume in /Users/jankneumann/Coding/agentic-coding-tools/.git-worktrees/harden-review-consensus-and-recovery and inspect git status before editing; preserve the untracked openspec/schemas/review-attempt.schema.json until its ownership is resolved.

Update the eight legacy dispatcher-migration fixtures or the compatibility boundary so every review manifest carries validated terminal attempt-chain evidence, then run: cd skills && uv run pytest tests/parallel-infrastructure/test_review_dispatcher_migration.py -q.

Run make decisions and make context-drift-gate; regenerate the decision timeline and use the refresh-architecture skill if the architecture producer remains unverifiable instead of masking the provenance failure.
Run openspec validate --strict --all and the relevant infrastructure test suite, commit only scoped fixes, push, and inspect the new PR #363 checks.

Do not request another IMPL_REVIEW cycle until external reviewer output reliability or routing has materially changed; any additional cycle requires explicit operator authorization and must not waive quorum.
After a future implementation review converges and CI is green, read validate-feature/SKILL.md and proceed through VALIDATE and validation review before marking the PR ready.
